Oversized bold head occupies upper-right 32x32, thick shaft about 10 conceptual pixels, strong steel teeth lower left. Old silver steel key with same family diagonal angle 45 degrees, thick steel shaft, two chunky teeth on lower left. Muted metal 3 shade steps, coloured head 3 shade steps, upper-left highlights, near-black outline 2 conceptual pixels thick (1px at final 32). Crisp detailed RETRO pixel art, substantial silhouette readable at 8x8. No text, no border, no ground shadow. Do not draw a thin realistic long key; exaggerate WIDTH and head so the whole silhouette fills a square.

entries.prompt: Create ONE standalone chunky retro survival horror inventory pixel-art key on true transparent background, no text. Pixel art designed as a 64x64 master filling essentially the entire square, for reduction to 32px: bold dark outline about 2 master pixels, 2-3 flat tones per material, <=16 colors, crisp pixels, no gradients. Key diagonally from lower left bit at (5,59) to upper right head centered (46,18). Thick bright silver shaft 8px wide from (12,51) to (37,29), with two chunky square teeth on lower-right edge near lower-left tip, stepped diagonal edges, grey metal highlight upper-left and dark underside. Large bold head occupies upper right 30x30 region. Overall bbox nearly 60x60. Same shaft geometry for all suit keys. This is modern car-style POWER ROOM key, not antique suit key. WIDE BRIGHT STEEL BLADE lower left, two PARALLEL FLAT ridged sections with white and light grey highlight strips extending from lower-left tip directly into plastic head. Broad blade not thin stem. BLACK rounded rectangular plastic head upper right, angled along diagonal shaft, dark green-black shadows and grey-green lit edges, small RED MARK on top face near center. Chunky wide silhouette fills square; head and blade each occupy roughly half diagonal length. NO keyring hole.

v8.method: New imagery described in words; references inspected only. Alpha-bbox crop, premultiplied Lanczos per channel to 64px master then 32px final; binary alpha threshold 0.5; opaque median-cut 15 colours; no dithering. No reference pixels in sprites.

Thick silver shaft (8 of 64 pixels wide), shaft axis runs southwest to northeast, square teeth near lower left on southeast edge. Dark 1px outline at final 32px, thin grey metal rim, 2-3 flat shades each material, <=16 colours, crisp chunky pixels no dithering or gradients. Head is a HEART rotated so pointed bottom tip faces SOUTHWEST and directly joins shaft, and two round lobes face outward NORTHEAST. Deep notch between lobes at northeast. Deep RED CRIMSON enamel, thin silver grey rim and tiny dark round hole at centre.
